breakpoint.conditionLabel: Condition expression (optional; pauses only when truthy)
breakpoint.conditionHint: Breakpoints are valid for this session only and are not saved with the Graph; a broken expression fails safe and is treated as not matching.
breakpoint.hitCountLabel: Hit count hitCount (pause once every N hits; leave empty to pause on every hit)
breakpoint.logMessageLabel: Log breakpoint logMessage (non-empty = only log on hit, do not pause)
breakpoint.logMessagePlaceholder: e.g. reached the refund node (the message is output as-is, no interpolation)
breakpoint.logMessageHint: When a message is provided this breakpoint becomes a log breakpoint: on hit it only prints to the debug console and does not pause the run; v1 does not combine it with hitCount and the message is emitted as-is without interpolation.
breakpoint.exceptionLabel: Exception breakpoint (pauses when the node raises, docs/28 §3.2)
breakpoint.exceptionHint: When enabled, an exception raised by the node logic pauses first and shows the exception type and message; it is re-raised as-is after step/continue (v1 cannot ignore and continue), and stop ends debugging; with no condition expression, continue mode pauses only when this node raises and does not pause on normal passage.

release.title: Release gate
release.intro: Batch-replays this graph's recorded cases against the current draft and compares node by node; any mismatched case blocks publishing (no new version is produced).
release.blocked: Gate failed: {{failed}}/{{total}} cases do not match; publishing is blocked
release.skipped: This graph has no replayable recorded cases (uncovered). The gate does not block publishing; recording golden cases first is recommended.
release.passed: Gate passed: {{passed}}/{{total}} cases all match; ready to publish.

upgrade.title: Subgraph version upgrade check
upgrade.hint: Publishing pins subgraph references to their corresponding versions; after an upgrade, run the gate for regression before publishing (read-only; subgraph draft changes are not checked)
upgrade.empty: No subgraph version changes in this release

diff.label: Config diff against {{base}} ({{summary}})
diff.empty: The two versions are structurally identical; there is no config diff.
diff.emptyHistory: No history reports yet (every gate run/publish is recorded here)

rollout.title: Rollout
rollout.needTwoVersions: (starting a canary requires at least 2 published versions)
rollout.rulesLocked: (canary in progress or finished; rule segments are locked. Roll back first to reconfigure)
rollout.internalRule: Internal tenants: events from matching tenants all go to candidate
rollout.canaryRule: Percentage canary (stable hash on order id; the same object never switches versions)
rollout.restHint: The remaining traffic goes to stable; after promote to full, all traffic goes to candidate (the full segment needs no configuration).
rollout.payloadInvalid: The event payload is not valid JSON
rollout.gateTitle: Gate (threshold breach auto-rolls back; alerts only, never auto-promotes)
rollout.simTitle: Simulate inbound events (sandbox verification of three-segment bucketing; no real webhook/IM ingress)

nodeTitles.parallel: Parallel fan-out (runs all branches concurrently, then joins, 04 §5.4)

wait.expressionHint: Evaluated at runtime; must be {{min}}-{{max}} seconds
